**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/24 (Wed) 18:03  
[USER] User needs a use case for an employee leave management system.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] An employee leave management system can streamline the leave request process for ABC Company, which has 500 employees and offers vacation, sick leave, personal leave, and bereavement leave.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Prior to the system, HR received leave requests via email or in-person and manually entered them into a spreadsheet, which was time-consuming and error-prone.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The leave management system allows employees to log in and submit leave requests, which are routed to managers for approval, tracking leave balances automatically.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The system improves accuracy and efficiency, resulting in fewer errors and faster processing times, with employees appreciating the convenience of online tracking.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Managers can approve or deny requests with a few clicks, and HR can generate reports on leave balances, usage, and trends.  
[USER] User requests a structure for the app.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Proposed app structure includes:  
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Login/Registration Screen  
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Dashboard  
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Leave Request Screen  
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Leave History Screen  
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Approvals Screen  
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Reports Screen  
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Settings Screen  
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Help/Support Screen  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The app should be user-friendly, with a clean interface, intuitive buttons, and strong data protection.  
[USER] User already has an employee management system and wants to add leave management for HR to track and approve leaves.  
[USER] User requests the database schema explained.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Proposed database schema includes:  
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Employee Table: employee_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone_number, hire_date  
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Leave Type Table: leave_type_id, name, description  
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Leave Request Table: leave_request_id, employee_id, leave_type_id, start_date, end_date, status, notes  
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Leave Balance Table: leave_balance_id, employee_id, leave_type_id, balance
